title: NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc8 Release
key_finding: Latest release (2026-10-28). Rust-native with PyO3. Python ≥3.12. Key additions: Lighter scheduled cancellation, OKX reconciliation history page limits, custom Python fill/latency/margin models, embedded Python strategies.

title: Lighter Integration — NautilusTrader
key_finding: Official Lighter adapter. Full order type support: LIMIT, MARKET, STOP_MARKET, STOP_LIMIT, MARKET_IF_TOUCHED, LIMIT_IF_TOUCHED. TIF: GTC, IOC, GTD (≥5min+1s), DAY. post_only, reduce_only. Native OTO/OCO/OTOCO via CreateGroupedOrders. No iceberg, no FOK, no trailing stops. L2 signing (Schnorr), 16-window nonce, account-wide cancel-all with scheduled renewal. Standard tier: 0/0 fees, 300ms taker speed bump, 60 req/min REST+sendTx shared, 40 mod/min transaction type limit.

title: OKX Integration — NautilusTrader (Chinese mirror)
key_finding: Official OKX adapter. Order types for SWAP: MARKET, MARKET_TO_LIMIT, LIMIT, STOP_MARKET, STOP_LIMIT, MARKET_IF_TOUCHED, LIMIT_IF_TOUCHED, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET. TIF: GTC, FOK, IOC; no native GTD (use manage_gtd_expiry). post_only, reduce_only. No iceberg. No native OCO/bracket submission (strategy-managed only). RPI maker/taker with price rounding. Conditional orders via HTTP algo API, status via WS. instIdCode-based order routing.

title: Execution — NautilusTrader
key_finding: OMS types: UNSPECIFIED, NETTING, HEDGING. Virtual positions when strategy/venue OMS differ. RiskEngine validates price/qty precision, notional bounds, reduce_only, balance, rate limits, trading state (ACTIVE/REDUCING/HALTED). Order path: Strategy → OrderEmulator/ExecutionAlgorithm/RiskEngine → ExecutionEngine → ExecutionClient. full_position_exit_venues for whole-position conditional exits.

title: Synthetics — NautilusTrader
key_finding: SyntheticInstrument with formula language: component references by InstrumentId, arithmetic ops, if(), min(), max(). Zero-allocation f64 evaluation (~12-28ns). Cannot trade directly — analytical only. Quotes derive from component quotes. Requires all components cached.

title: Strategies — NautilusTrader
key_finding: Strategy inherits DataActor. Handlers: on_start, on_stop, on_quote, on_trade, on_bar, on_order_filled/accepted/rejected/canceled, on_position_opened/changed/closed, on_time_event. Specific→general dispatch. OrderFactory for creating orders. Clock for timers.

title: Orders — NautilusTrader
key_finding: Nine order types: MARKET, LIMIT, STOP_MARKET, STOP_LIMIT, MARKET_TO_LIMIT, MARKET_IF_TOUCHED, LIMIT_IF_TOUCHED, TRAILING_STOP_MARKET, TRAILING_STOP_LIMIT. TIF: GTC, IOC, FOK, GTD, DAY. Instructions: post_only, reduce_only, display_qty (iceberg). Trigger types: LAST, MARK, INDEX, BID_ASK, MID_POINT, etc. 15 statuses from INITIALIZED to VOIDED.

title: Advanced orders — NautilusTrader
key_finding: OTO (One-Triggers-Other): parent releases children on fill. OCO (One-Cancels-Other): fill cancels siblings. OUO (One-Updates-Other): fill updates sibling quantity. Strategy-managed via StrategyConfig.manage_contingent_orders. OrderList groups contingent orders. Bracket via OrderFactory.bracket.

title: Lighter adapter: Order types, TIF, execution instructions
key_finding: Detailed per-order-type support: MARKET uses cached far-side quote+slippage cap (default 50bps). STOP_MARKET/MARKET_IF_TOUCHED use trigger_price+slippage. Conditional orders require trigger_price. Contingent groups: same-market only, OTO parent (MARKET/LIMIT) + OCO-linked children (reduce_only, same qty). Children share nonzero expiry. Held children cannot be modified at zero venue quantity. Modification: one pending at a time; second denied. Cancel-all: per-order in batches of 15; native account-wide via Rust client.

title: Lighter adapter: Account, positions, reconciliation
key_finding: Six private WS streams: account_all_orders, account_all_trades, account_all_positions, account_all_assets, account_tx, user_stats. One net position per perpetual market. Classic mode separates spot/perp funds. Startup: subscribed/account_all_positions snapshot authoritative. Reconnect: wait 30s for 5 snapshot streams ready. Liquidation/ADL: normal fill path, classification lost. PositionStatusReport.liquidation_price preserved.

title: Execution Reconciliation — NautilusTrader
key_finding: Startup reconciliation aligns cache with venue state. Explicit position report is authoritative. Order-only fill projection when no position report. Reconciliation tolerances. Mass status combines orders, fills, cached positions. Fill voids correct prior cycles.

title: Risk — NautilusTrader (API ref redirect)
key_finding: (404 on direct page, but concepts/execution covers RiskEngine). RiskEngineConfig fields: bypass, max_order_submit, max_order_modify, max_notional_per_order, full_position_exit_venues, debug.

title: NautilusTrader Releases
key_finding: Release history: 1.x Beta series → 2.0.0rc1 through rc8 (2026-09-02 to 2026-10-28). 2.0 removes Cython, moves to pure PyO3. Active development: ~300+ commits between rc releases.

title: Data Catalog — NautilusTrader
key_finding: ParquetDataCatalog stores data in Parquet for backtesting, live, research. Python interface to Rust catalog + DataFusion query engine. Supports instruments, quotes, trades, bars, order book deltas/depths. BacktestNode replays from catalog.

title: arbTwin README
key_finding: Two-venue basis engine: OKX (USDT perp) ↔ Lighter (USDC perp). wave mode: one round at a time, post-only legs, partial fill → bounded naked leg, passive unwind, frozen-price exit with IOC escalation. 181 overlapping symbols. Mechanics gates: mark window, OI, 1% depth, liq distance. Unit calibration via ratio CV + return correlation. Unit ratio for approved symbols ≈1.0.

title: arbTwin wave state machine
key_finding: RoundState: FLAT→ENTRY→ENTRY_PARTIAL→HEDGED→EXIT_BUY/SELL→EXIT_COMPLETE→FLAT. ABORT_UNWIND for naked leg. WaveParams: entry_deadline_s (900), exit_deadline_s (300), max_unhedged_notional_usd (150), adverse_move_stop_bps (12). Freeze exit prices on trigger. Re-peg: same-price skip. Escalation to IOC after deadline. Only risk stop uses marketable orders.

title: Multi-lens review of arbTwin
key_finding: 9 corrections applied: b* (breakeven basis) added, anchor wired, orphan detection on restart, same-price re-peg skip, min_edge_bps→2.0, screening cost口径 fix. Remaining: tick-level capture_fraction measurement, depth snapshot TTL reduction, round recovery semantics, client_order_index idempotency.

title: arbTwin position reconciliation
key_finding: PositionLedger: disk-persisted, poll-driven, delta-based. observe() compares current vs stored position qty. seed() adopts current without emitting fills. reconcile() processes a full positions dict. This approach is superseded by NT's event-sourced engine reconciliation.
